summary: Clearway main road at a junction, no kerb parking, apartments 19 m away.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked at kerb

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 19 m from the kerb at the start; apartments and houses line the other side of the lane; shops opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a multi-lane through road with a bus lane and junction; no parking lane or pull-off, no parked cars on this stretch.
drivers.traffic: Heavy through traffic and a signalised junction.
drivers.convention: No kerb parking here; a Clearway C sign applies Mon-Fri 7am-7pm.

sun_shade: Open to sky; a few trees near the junction on the east side.

best_section.where: east kerb of Coonan Street just north of the junction
